description: Confirm a write that another tool on this server previewed, using ONLY the confirmToken from its "confirmation-required" response: the server kept that call's arguments, so do not send them again. Pass the token only after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat. One token acts once. Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a "confirmation-required" response on this server.
